milestones.S1.0 — Decision contracts: Typed boolean/choice/score synthetic engineering exists; proposed verified-plan extraction is separately tracked. Core tests are not semantic-model acceptance, calibrated reliability or activation. Evidence/resumption index: docs/system-one/README.md.

T025 integration engineering is closed on reused T024 fixtures; independent/human acceptance remains pending. Original representative/human/calibration gates stay pending; no general accuracy claim. Index: docs/system-one/README.md.
milestones.S1.2 — Native decision model: Isolated neural software and bounded EN/ES taxonomy training/comparison/resident-runtime evidence exist, including negative transfer and cold-start limits. Broader rights, common architecture evaluation, human workflow acceptance and promotion remain pending. Index: docs/system-one/README.md.
milestones.S1.3 — Advisory integration: Synthetic advisory adapters and bounded native preparation/transport studies exist; native workflow utility target was not met. Versioned EOF integration and reusable acquisition/consumer proposals are tracked separately; no grants or activation implied. Index: docs/system-one/README.md.
milestones.S1.4 — Product capabilities and promotio: Selected schema compiler, metadata router and hooks have engineering evidence; catalogue/export/batching branches remain independently selected/deferred. Shadow, drift, rollback, human/founder per-capability promotion and activation remain pending. Index: docs/system-one/README.md.
milestones.FC.1 — Forecast-guided parallelism exper: Permissioned workload telemetry, optional local Chronos-2, prospective forecasting/complete-cost parallelism experiment and separately governed shadow/promotion. Negative or infeasible outcomes are valid; no new execution domain or M4 closure.
milestones.M4.5 — AI tooling integrations for Codex: Adjacent to bounded-complete M4; historical G4 NO-GO and negative utility preserved. The combined source portfolio has 10 specs and 131 tasks (102 checked, 29 open), with 3 historically closed parents, the closed SPEC-054 parent and 6 open parents (SPEC-060 adds the draft portable prompt names contract and its 11 tasks); source counts do not assert remote issue closure. SPEC-039/040/042 retain bounded accepted scopes and SPEC-044/T004 retains its historical bounded closure. SPEC-046 owns native plugins and its 19 tasks (T016–T019 are an unpublished stale-registry defect fix); external candidacy approvals remain pending. SPEC-047 adds default-off local aggregate telemetry. Existing Luna review is bound to b2cf477fe9f9; integration adaptations and resulting candidate have separate review/validation. Pilot NO-GO; T017/T018/T010, native observations, ADR adoption, human/founder acceptance and M4.5 closure remain open.
milestones.FC.2 — Local forecasting capabilities: Local default-off API/CLI/MCP forecasting, synthetic engineering/reproduction and separately approved actual Chronos CPU conformance; no real workload utility or promotion implied.
milestones.HAR.1 — Braid Harness laboratory: Provide a native Agent Braid mechanism to propose, probe and compose small task-local harness variants against an immutable base, first with deterministic fixtures and later through separately qualified Codex/Claude adapters. Draft planning; no due date, native acceptance or activation implied. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
milestones.HAR.2 — Braid Harness evaluation and lea: Determine separately whether harness refinement improves long-task continuity and agent coordination, then retain only scoped evidence-supported lessons and make explicit human or future automatic promotion decisions. Draft planning; no due date, native acceptance or activation implied. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
milestones.HAR.3 — Braid Harness adaptation and int: Implement staged Braid Harness component profiles, skills/helpers/hooks, delegated orchestration, measured depth/width refinement, scoped curation, disabled automatic-policy software and opt-in lifecycle/product integration. Draft planning; native qualification, exact policy adoption and activation remain separate. EUR 0 extra spend.
milestones.M4.6 — Claude Code dynamic workflows: Read-only Agent Braid evidence for Claude Code dynamic workflows and orchestrator-style parallel agents: integration gate (SPEC-052), G0-gated transcript adapter (SPEC-053), advisory ownership/pre-flight/checkpoint/recovery core (SPEC-057), G1-gated opt-in guard (SPEC-058) and G2-gated ledger/push (SPEC-059); planning only, no execution authority. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
